sentence: This project builds a deep learning transceiver that keeps the error rate low in all types of wireless channels.
This project uses quantum computing techniques to address challenges in power systems.
This project builds solutions that analyze dynamic and evolving relationships in large-scale data efficiently and accurately on diverse hardware.
This project studies how yeast cells control the actin network that helps pull part of the cell membrane into the cell.
This project develops defenses that learn online to protect real-world servers from cyberattacks and come with provable guarantees.
This project builds machine learning models that turn text descriptions into computer programs that produce 3D objects users can adjust.
This project builds open-source software that simulates the magnetic and electronic properties of strongly correlated materials.
This project studies how changing environmental conditions and human activities affect estuaries and coastal wetlands, and whether variability helps predict their responses.
This project develops ways to use bacteriophages to control bacteria that cause problems in wastewater treatment.
This project uses noisy quantum computers to study a quantum state of matter called the fractional quantum Hall state.
This project tries to find out how cells in two butterfly species develop, take on different functions and build wing scales.
This project builds software tools that use natural language processing and machine learning to measure the quality of relationships in schools.
This project studies a group of parasites and the bacteria living inside them to find out how a parasite became a harmless inhabitant.
This project builds a mathematical model of how HIV becomes resistant to a long-acting injectable drug used for treatment and prevention.
This project brings together seabird, ocean and food data from three research sites to find out how seabird communities respond to changing ocean conditions.
This project builds tools that combine particle simulation and deep learning to solve equations that are challenging to compute by traditional methods.
This project develops algorithms that let robots use millimeter-wave radar to sense their surroundings and navigate where vision is poor.
